renewed_jury_gate.reviewer_requirement: fresh gpt-5.6-sol xhigh read-only review; same-family verdict is provisional
renewed_jury_gate.review_input: raw bytes of the fixed v2 protocol, AUTORESEARCH_CONFIG_HYBRID_EXPANDED.json, input manifest, proposal, experiment plan, tracker, research contract, preregistration lock, and their SHA256 values
renewed_jury_gate.allowed_before_pass: local specification repair and remote read-only provenance/environment/device checks only; no remote mutation, scientific GPU/data-outcome launch, treatment training, simulator outcome, or live robot command
renewed_jury_gate.pass_semantics: only GO or an explicit condition-by-condition CONDITIONAL-GO authorizes the named scope; silence, READY from an older protocol, or a hash mismatch authorizes nothing

claim_ceiling.engineering_canary: environment, strict model load, parity, sealed-output, and throughput evidence only
claim_ceiling.simulation_C0: held-out action-conditioned future association on the treatment-blind eligible LIBERO-10 task set
claim_ceiling.simulation_C1: two-cohort task-local controlled algorithmic effect relative to B and one fixed C placebo
claim_ceiling.simulation_C2: two-cohort task-local placebo-relative reliance on one offline predictive projector
claim_ceiling.real_robot: one-platform task-local real-robot evidence only after a separate robot/domain contract passes safety and scientific review
claim_ceiling.cross_domain: simulation and real-robot results are reported separately; if both independently pass they provide convergent cross-domain evidence; call it replication only if the later frozen real contract preserves the simulation estimand, task semantics, intervention, and comparator
forbidden: real-robot generality without at least two independent embodiments or platforms

canonical_hashing.json: sha256(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8')) using Python 3.11.15; no BOM and no trailing newline
canonical_hashing.directory: reject every symlink and non-regular entry; sort regular files by POSIX relative path Unicode code-point order; for each file append the canonical JSON object with exactly keys bytes,path,sha256 followed by one LF byte; include a final LF after the last record; sha256 the concatenated bytes

filesystem_contract.project_data_artifact_io: every project, data, model, checkpoint, environment, cache, temporary, log, metric, video, W&B, and result path must be specified under the logical personal root and resolve under the canonical personal root
filesystem_contract.new_output_rule: canonical parent must pass the personal-root check before creation; reject symlink escape; use umask 077; output UUID directories must not preexist
runtime_read_only_exceptions: /proc entries needed for the current launch and GPU occupancy
system executables and read-only runtime libraries
filesystem_contract.runtime_exception_limits: exceptions may not be used to read project data, model data, checkpoints, another user's home, or team/shared storage and may never be written
forbidden_actions: read or write team/shared project, dataset, model, or checkpoint trees
kill, attach to, overwrite, or reuse an unrelated process
touch the dirty CF-DynAlign source as an experiment runtime

dirty_source.policy: read-only provenance audit only; never modify and never use as the H1 runtime

allowed_control_networks_now: existing SSH connection from the user's Windows OpenSSH client to <PRIVATE_SERVER>
host_environment.robot_network_unlock: only the separately frozen real contract may add exact host,port,transport,authentication,API-version, and command-namespace entries; an empty allowlist forbids robot connectivity
host_environment.implementation_dependency_rule: use only locked environment packages; PCA, ridge, bootstrap, and statistics use NumPy, SciPy, or PyTorch; scikit-learn is not present and must not be installed

gpu_policy.conditional_rule: physical 0 or 1 may be used whenever the fresh snapshot for that launch shows that candidate GPU idle; all four GPUs need not be simultaneously idle

rng.role_derivation_fallback: uint64 big-endian first 8 bytes of SHA256 of PGR-Audit-v2|role={role}|train_seed={train_seed}|master=1701

determinism.process_seed: before interpreter start set PYTHONHASHSEED to the logical role seed; at process entry set Python random, NumPy legacy RNG when used, an explicit NumPy PCG64 Generator, torch CPU, and torch.cuda.manual_seed_all to that same logged role seed
determinism.role_seed: screen and simulator use7, decoder/head uses1701, each adapter/PQ logical run uses its train_seed plus the domain-separated formulas in rng; never reuse an implicit global RNG across roles
determinism.torch: set torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic=True, torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark=False, torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=False, torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32=False, and torch.set_float32_matmul_precision('highest')
determinism.environment: set CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 and TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false before CUDA initialization
determinism.data_loading: num_workers=0 for every scientific cache, decoder, adapter, projector, and evaluation loader; batch-index manifests rather than loader iteration are authoritative
determinism.failure: an unsupported nondeterministic operation, unseeded RNG call, seed mismatch, or determinism-setting mismatch fails closed before the affected scientific artifact; tolerated nondeterminism is empty unless separately preregistered and re-juried before any outcome
determinism.audit: persist resolved environment variables, library determinism flags, all role seeds, RNG states at start/end, batch hashes, hardware UUIDs, and repeatability-canary hashes

execution_graph.freeze_node: freeze and hash the v2 protocol, active autoresearch config, full LIBERO-10 input manifest, both fixed seed cohorts, all-ten-task screen rule, lane independence, quarantine rules, and source/environment locks
execution_graph.jury_node: obtain renewed jury authorization bound to the frozen hashes; the earlier budget-constrained jury and lock are superseded
execution_graph.common_implementation_node: after jury authorization, create isolated personal source, materialize locks, implement common PGR, simulation code, default-off RobotAdapter, launch guard, sealing, and telemetry; pass CPU tests and fresh-agent code review

execution_graph.forbidden_edge: no executor may infer an S-LIBERO10-to-R-REAL admission edge or an R-REAL-to-S-LIBERO10 admission edge

split_algorithm.sort_key: full lowercase SHA256 hex of UTF-8 PGR-Audit-v2|task={dataset_task_index}|episode={episode_index}|stream={stream}|seed=1701; tie episode_index ascending
split_algorithm.stream_scope: outer sorts the full per-task episode set; head and post each re-sort only their parent partition with the exact literal; head_nuisance_cv re-sorts only D_head-train
split_algorithm.allocator: constraint-first within each task: require n>=29; reserve the fixed minimum counts for every label; distribute only n-29 remaining episodes by floor r*p then descending fractional remainder with declared label-order tie break; assign the SHA-sorted episode list to contiguous label blocks; repeat the same minimum-then-remainder rule inside D_head and D_post
data_gates: every task has at least 29 episodes before allocation
all ten tasks occur in every outer partition
all ten tasks occur in every D_head subset and D_post fold
D_head train has at least five distinct episodes per task; val and strict-test each have at least three
every one of the five D_head-train nuisance-CV folds has at least one distinct episode from every task
D_adapter has at least three distinct episodes per task
D_post folds0 through fold4 each have at least three distinct episodes per task
D_head strict-test has at least three episodes per task
D_post fold4 has at least three episodes per task
no episode may be moved after allocation
if any minimum fails, stop before cache or projector fit and refreeze a scientifically reviewed split; never repair by moving individual episodes
split_algorithm.freeze_before_screen: persist and hash every episode-to-partition assignment, per-task count table, and allocation-code hash before the checkpoint screen

data.valid_window: retain t only when t + 8 < episode_length; never pad or cross an episode
data.host_processor: selected checkpoint's clean-HEAD QwenOFT processor in eval mode with no random augmentation; resolved config and source hashes must match INPUT_MANIFEST.json
data.adapter_preflight: before C construction, persist per-task episode and valid-window counts plus the chosen global merge level, bipartite degree diagnostics, and actual perfect-bijection verdict; task index6 has the binding three-episode D_adapter minimum and any infeasibility stops the simulation lane

action_normalization.dimension_6_gripper: identity, matching the clean Libero4in1DataConfig which does not normalize action.gripper

host_model.checkpoint_state_contract: each screened checkpoint must strict-load exactly730 state keys, every key beginning qwen_vl_interface. or action_model.; reject any missing, unexpected, predictor, lambda_cf, cf_, dynalign, future_head, or world_model key/string; historical config paths are never followed
host_model.action_head_loss: mean absolute error over batch, 8 tokens, and 7 normalized action dimensions

adapter.formula: m = h + U @ V @ LN0(h) applied tokenwise
adapter.layer_norm: population variance over 2560 features, eps 1e-5, no affine

future_target.encoder: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 local source and local weight, strict state-dict load, eval, FP32, x_norm_clstoken

whitening.covariance: population covariance per camera in FP64

projection.generator: NumPy PCG64 seed 1701, draw main then wrist, each Gaussian matrix shape 384 by 32
projection.orthonormalization: reduced QR; fix each column sign so its maximum-absolute element is positive

future_target.target: concatenate the 32-D main and 32-D wrist projected whitened differences

nuisance_residualization.covariates: z-scored current main CLS, z-scored current wrist CLS, ten-way dataset-task one-hot ordered 0..9, progress, intercept
nuisance_residualization.continuous_stats: D_head train only with population std floor 1e-6
nuisance_residualization.cv: constraint-first five episode-level task-stratified folds: reserve one SHA-ordered D_head-train episode from every task in each fold, then allocate remaining episodes equally by largest remainder with stream head_nuisance_cv and fold-order tie break; every fold must contain every task
nuisance_residualization.selection: minimum task-equal D_head-val nMSE rounded to 12 decimals; tie choose larger alpha
nuisance_residualization.train_target: out-of-fold residual on D_head train at selected alpha
nuisance_residualization.other_target: fit ridge on all D_head train and subtract prediction on val, strict-test, D_adapter, and D_post
nuisance_residualization.linear_solver: FP64 solve of Z^T Z + alpha*D; use Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse with rcond 1e-12 only if direct solve fails; record fallback and fail if nonfinite

predictive_decoder.ln0: population feature normalization eps 1e-5 no affine per token
predictive_decoder.state_branch: mean across 8 LN0 tokens, Linear 2560 to 256 with bias, GELU
predictive_decoder.action_branch: flatten exact 8 by 7 normalized action chunk, Linear 56 to 128 with bias, GELU
predictive_decoder.fusion: concatenate to exactly 384 dimensions, Linear 384 to 256 with bias, GELU, Linear 256 to 64 with bias
predictive_decoder.initialization: PyTorch 2.6.0 default Linear initialization under seed 1701
predictive_decoder.training_loss: mean squared error over batch and 64 target dimensions

batching.counter_base: epoch and batch indices are zero-based
batching.batch_composition: 25 samples per task plus one extra sample for six distinct tasks; extra-task IDs at global batch b are [(6*b+j) mod10 for j=0..5], giving exactly256 samples
batching.task_queues: at each epoch start, independently permute every task's D_head-train sample IDs with a torch.Generator seed equal to uint64 big-endian first8 SHA256 bytes of exact UTF-8 PGR-Audit-v2|decoder|task={dataset_task_index}|epoch={zero_based_epoch}|cycle={zero_based_cycle}|master=1701; start cycle=0, consume cyclic queues, and on exhaustion reshuffle that task's full list with cycle incremented; never drop or pad
batching.batches_per_epoch: ceil(max_task_sample_count/25); every batch is full and there is no tail batch
batching.manifest: before any decoder/control optimization, pre-generate and hash every epoch's ordered batch-index array for epochs0..99; these arrays are the final batching source of truth and every neural control uses the identical arrays while it remains active
batching.early_stop: validate only after a complete epoch; improvement is task-equal val joint64 nMSE rounded to12 decimals strictly below the prior best; tie keeps earliest epoch; stop after10 consecutive completed non-improving epochs or epoch99, then restore the earliest best epoch

predictive_decoder.selection: lowest task-equal D_head-val joint64 nMSE rounded to 12 decimals; tie earliest completed epoch

controls.common_training: same optimizer, batches, epochs, early stopping, and seed as full unless control is closed form
controls.state_only: same full architecture with the 56-D action input identically zero in train and evaluation
controls.action_only: same full architecture with the 2560-D pooled representation input identically zero in train and evaluation
controls.current_dino_action: z-scored concatenated current main and wrist CLS, Linear 768 to 256 with bias and GELU, then the same action branch and 384 to 256 to 64 fusion
controls.additive: same state and action branches; Linear 256 to 64 with bias plus Linear 128 to 64 without bias
controls.nuisance_ridge: same nuisance covariates and alpha grid fit directly to residual target
controls.task_progress_mean: D_head-train dataset-task by progress-decile mean; empty bin falls back to task mean then global mean

nmse.reference_mean: D_head-train residual target mean for the evaluated coordinate set
nmse.per_task: sum squared prediction error divided by sum squared deviation from fixed train reference mean
nmse.aggregate: equal mean over the treatment-blind primary eligible task set; also compute and report the equal mean over all ten tasks

metrics.derangement_degradation: nMSE(deranged full decoder) / nMSE(intact full decoder) - 1

bootstrap.sampling: within every scored task sample the original number of episodes with replacement and retain every window of each sampled episode; task-equal aggregate

metrics.projector_r2: task-equal mean of 1 - SSE(model)/SSE(zero), where zero is the folds0-1 fit-target mean and each task is scored separately
metrics.permutation_p: (1 + count(T_perm >= T_observed)) / 1001 using 1000 within-task episode-block target permutations

strict_predictive_gate.evaluated_once_on: D_head strict_test after selected checkpoint, primary eligible task set, decoder, nuisance, whitening, projections, splits, preprocessing, controls, and hashes freeze
strict_predictive_gate.holdout_open_semantics: one sealed logical evaluation specification; an allowed unchanged-hash infrastructure retry may physically reread strict-test only if no metric, aggregate, rank decision, or comparative output from the failed attempt was revealed to any adaptive process; record every physical access in the ledger; any reveal, code/config/hash change, or non-allowlisted retry invalidates C0-S

derangement_mapping_contract.inputs: D_head strict-test sample IDs, task IDs, episode IDs, t, progress, and demonstrated normalized56-D action norm only; future target, representation values, decoder predictions, losses, and treatment outcomes are forbidden
merge_levels: task x progress-decile x action groups {0,1} or {2}
derangement_mapping_contract.algorithm: for action and representation maps separately, choose the first whole-dataset merge level at which every task-stratum admits a perfect bijection; within each stratum solve float64 SciPy linear_sum_assignment with invalid infinity edges for same sample, same episode, or overlapping t..t+8 windows
derangement_mapping_contract.cost: squared progress difference divided by the stratum-wide finite-pair population variance floored1e-8 plus squared demonstrated normalized-action RMS-norm difference divided by its variance floored1e-8
derangement_mapping_contract.tie_break: add 1e-12 times uint64 big-endian first8 SHA256 bytes divided by2^64; exact no-space UTF-8 string is PGR-Audit-v2|C0-{map_role}|query_task={query_dataset_task_index}|query_episode={query_episode_index}|query_t={query_t}|donor_task={donor_dataset_task_index}|donor_episode={donor_episode_index}|donor_t={donor_t}|seed=1701, with map_role exactly action or representation and decimal integers without leading zeros
derangement_mapping_contract.freeze: construct and hash both complete maps plus merge level, code hash, feasibility diagnostics, and all IDs before any strict-test decoder metric is evaluated; bootstrap resamples episodes but never rebuilds or reselects a map
derangement_mapping_contract.failure: non-bijection, duplicate donor, fixed point, invalid edge, missing sample, or no globally feasible merge level is C0-S failure

action_derangement.constraints: different episode, same task, progress-decile and action-norm-tercile when feasible; use the fixed C merge hierarchy; no fixed point

representation_derangement.constraints: different episode, same task, progress-decile and action-norm-tercile when feasible; keep the demonstrated action fixed; use the fixed C merge hierarchy; no fixed point

strict_predictive_gate.conjunction: full-vs-strongest-control, action-derangement, and representation-derangement must each pass both its point threshold and bootstrap-LCB threshold in both joint64 and main32; any one failure is C0-S failure
strict_predictive_gate.failure: simulation C1-S/C2-S NO-RUN before adapter training; C0-S is recorded as failed; R-REAL remains unaffected
strict_predictive_gate.scored_tasks: primary eligible task set from the treatment-blind baseline screen; all-ten-task values are mandatory secondary coverage

fixed_c_placebo.action_norm: L2 norm of flattened normalized 56-D action divided by sqrt(56)
fixed_c_placebo.action_terciles: per dataset task on D_adapter using NumPy quantile method inverted_cdf; an exact boundary belongs to the lower bin
merge_levels: progress decile with all action terciles
progress quintile floor(decile/2) with all action terciles
progress half floor(decile/5) with all action terciles
fixed_c_placebo.merge_selection: choose the first whole-dataset level at which every stratum has a perfect bijective derangement under different-episode and nonoverlapping-window constraints; do not choose locally or by outcome
fixed_c_placebo.huber: elementwise 0.5*e^2 if abs(e)<=1 else abs(e)-0.5, mean over 64 dimensions
fixed_c_placebo.target_scalar: L2 target norm divided by sqrt(64)
fixed_c_placebo.cost: squared standardized query-donor target-norm difference plus squared standardized difference between intact identity Huber loss and query-prediction-to-donor-target Huber loss
fixed_c_placebo.cost_scales: population standard deviations over all eligible D_adapter pairs, each floored at 1e-8
fixed_c_placebo.solver: SciPy linear_sum_assignment in float64; invalid edges are infinity
fixed_c_placebo.tie_break: add 1e-12 times uint64 big-endian first8 SHA256 bytes divided by2^64 to every finite cost; exact no-space UTF-8 string is PGR-Audit-v2|C|query_task={query_dataset_task_index}|query_episode={query_episode_index}|query_t={query_t}|donor_task={donor_dataset_task_index}|donor_episode={donor_episode_index}|donor_t={donor_t}|seed=1701, with decimal integers without leading zeros

pretraining_gates.scope: compute donor/query mean target-norm ratio, matched-C/intact mean identity-Huber ratio, and absolute Huber-saturation-rate difference separately for every one of the ten dataset tasks and also report their task-equal aggregate; every task must pass every gate and any zero denominator fails

arms.A: action gradient plus valid future-target gradient
arms.B: action-update-only control: on B's current adapter compute the same valid-target future forward and full backward gradient as A, log its norm/nonfinite/dose diagnostics, then discard it; update B parameters only with B's own action gradient
arms.C: action gradient plus fixed C-donor future-target gradient

shared.batching: for global zero-based batch b=0..499 use25 samples per task plus extra-task IDs [(6*b+j+train_seed) mod10 for j=0..5]; per-task cyclic queues are shuffled without replacement with torch.Generator seed equal to uint64 big-endian first8 SHA256 bytes of exact UTF-8 PGR-Audit-v2|adapter-batch|train_seed={train_seed}|task={dataset_task_index}|cycle={zero_based_cycle}|base={10000+train_seed}, reshuffling on exhaustion with cycle incremented; pre-generate and hash all500 full256-index arrays before any arm update; those arrays are final and A/B/C share exactly
shared.dtype: FP32 gradients, norms, scales, and updates

adapter_training.future_loss: mean elementwise Huber delta 1 over batch and 64 dimensions
adapter_training.gradient_norm: L2 over the concatenation of every U and V gradient element before clipping
adapter_training.action_gradient: compute each arm's own action-loss gradient at that arm's current adapter parameters on the common batch; B always applies its own action-only globally clipped update

dose.rho: 0.30 * norm of B action gradient on the common batch
dose.composition: on a passing batch, A and C each combine that arm's own action gradient with its own scaled future gradient, then apply global norm clip 1.0; B applies its own action gradient with the same clip
dose.fallback: future norm <=1e-12, rho<=1e-12, scale hits either cap, or relative error >0.01
dose.fallback_update: if either A or C triggers fallback, both A and C omit the future component for that batch and each applies only its own action gradient after global clip1; B applies its normal own action-only update; log both arms' trigger booleans and reasons so A and C always receive the same number of auxiliary-dose batches
dose.failure: more than five joint fallback batches or a pass fraction below0.99 invalidates the seed with no replacement

adapter_training.nonfinite: immediate seed invalid and stop that launch

predictive_projector.delta: mean across 8 tokens of m_A - m_B in 2560-D

fold_roles.fold2: alpha and rank selection plus permutation gate

nuisance.covariates: z-scored current DINO main and wrist CLS, demonstrated normalized action chunk, ten-way task one-hot, progress, intercept
nuisance.crossfit: fit fold0 predict fold1 and fit fold1 predict fold0 for delta and target independently
nuisance.selection: lowest average task-equal OOF nMSE rounded to 12 decimals; tie larger alpha
nuisance.refit: union folds0-1 at the selected alpha for folds2-4

W.fit_values: fold0-1 OOF delta residuals after nuisance subtraction
W.raw_center: mean raw delta on folds0-1, stored as mu_delta
W.dimension: smallest d explaining at least 95 percent residual variance, capped at 128
W.matrix: diag(retained_eigenvalues^-0.5) times retained eigenvectors transpose, shape d by 2560
W.rank_tolerance: numerical rank uses singular values strictly greater than max(shape)*machine_epsilon*largest_singular_value in FP64
W.failure: largest residual eigenvalue <=0, d<=0, insufficient finite samples in any task, or any nonfinite value makes Stage2 ineligible; Stage1 is unaffected

B_N.values: W times centered union-refit nuisance-predicted delta on folds0-1
B_N.basis: left singular vectors in W space explaining at least 95 percent nuisance-prediction energy
B_N.zero_energy: empty basis when total squared singular value <=1e-12

p_fit.method: multivariate ridge coefficient from W-space OOF residual delta to OOF residual target, then truncate coefficient SVD
p_fit.basis: take coefficient left singular vectors, project into complement of B_N, reduced QR with canonical positive signs
p_fit.selection: lowest task-equal fold2 nMSE rounded to 12 decimals; tie lower rank then larger alpha
p_fit.invalid_candidate: if W dimension or numerical rank after projection into complement(B_N) is below the nominal requested rank, exclude that alpha/rank candidate without silently reducing rank; if no candidate remains, Stage2 is ineligible and Stage1 is unaffected
p_fit.permutation_selection_correction: T_observed is incremental R2 of the alpha/rank selected by the frozen fold2 rule; for each of 1000 within-task episode-block target permutations rerun the complete valid-candidate alpha/rank selection and use that permutation's selected incremental R2 as T_perm; p=(1+count(T_perm>=T_observed))/1001; a permutation with no valid candidate has T_perm=-infinity

q_fit.generation: Gaussian d by selected-rank matrix from the fixed candidate seed; project into complement of B_N and B_pred; reduced QR with canonical signs
q_fit.invalid: numerical rank less than selected rank
q_fit.fold3_energy_ratio_definition: task-equal mean over fold3 samples of squared L2 norm of v_pred divided by the corresponding task-equal mean squared L2 norm of v_q
q_fit.fold3_action_perturbation_ratios: for each of all 10 tasks and each of 8 action tokens, RMS over fold3 samples and 7 normalized action dimensions of action(intact A)-action(A with v_pred removed), divided by the analogous RMS for v_q removal; all 80 ratios must be in [0.9,1.1]
q_fit.equivalence_zero_denominator: if the v_q energy denominator or any Q-removal action-change RMS denominator is <=1e-12, that Q candidate is invalid; if no candidate remains, Stage2 is ineligible
q_fit.score: squared log energy ratio plus mean squared log of the 80 task-token action perturbation ratios
q_fit.selection: lowest score rounded to 12 decimals; tie lower candidate index

projectors.nuisance_overlap: compute separately for R in {B_pred,B_Q} as Frobenius norm of R.T @ B_N divided by sqrt(rank(R)); persist both values and require both <=0.001

deployment.pseudoinverse: NumPy pinv(W,rcond=1e-8), linear only and never restore a mean
deployment.application: subtract the same 2560-D vector from each of the 8 A tokens

parity_contract.reserved_trace_selection: before A/B/C training, among candidates whose t..t+15 are sixteen consecutive valid sample windows, select one D_adapter trace per dataset task by minimum lowercase SHA256 of exact no-space UTF-8 PGR-Audit-v2|parity-trace|task={dataset_task_index}|episode={episode_index}|start_t={start_t}|seed=1701; tie lower episode then start_t; selection uses identifiers only and no treatment outcome
parity_contract.manifest: persist and hash all ten task, episode, start_t, window sample IDs, source image/action hashes, selected-checkpoint hash, cache schema, and selection-code hash
parity_contract.cached_A_to_B: for every seed and reserved window, subtract the full cached per-token m_A-m_B vector from m_A and require the frozen action-head output to match direct cached B normalized actions
parity_contract.direct_trace: for every seed and each of ten traces, replay identical cached observations through direct and cached wrappers with the same full A-to-B intervention; compare all 16x8x7 normalized action values
parity_contract.threshold: maximum absolute normalized-action error over every seed, task, trace, window, token, and action coordinate must be <1e-6
parity_contract.failure: any missing trace, hash mismatch, or threshold failure makes Stage2 ineligible; no trace replacement

empirical_support.coordinate: x=W@(raw mean-token A-B delta-mu_delta); distance is L2(x)/sqrt(d), with d the locked W row count
empirical_support.reference: within each task, compute the folds0-3 distance 0.99 quantile using NumPy method inverted_cdf and the intact-A normalized policy-action coordinatewise min/max for every token and action dimension
empirical_support.fold4_distance_gate: for every task, the equal-episode mean of the fraction of fold4 windows with distance above that task's reference threshold must be <=0.05
empirical_support.fold4_action_gate: for each of intact A, A_pred_removed, and A_Q_removed and every task, at least0.99 of all fold4 token-by-action-coordinate values must lie within the corresponding intact-A folds0-3 coordinatewise min/max
empirical_support.zero_or_nonfinite: d<=0, an empty task, any nonfinite value, or a zero denominator makes Stage2 ineligible
empirical_support.report: persist taskwise thresholds, episode counts, exceedance fractions, action in-range fractions, and hashes; no task pooling may hide a failure

predictive_projector.fold4_r2: fit a readout from projected coordinates to residual target on folds0-1 with selected alpha; score task-equal R2 on fold4; Q uses the same alpha without retuning
predictive_projector.fold4_equivalence_recheck: using locked P and Q, recompute on fold4 the identical task-equal P/Q removed-energy ratio and all 80 task-token RMS normalized-action-change ratios; every denominator must exceed 1e-12 and every ratio must remain in [0.9,1.1]

stage1_measurement_contract.split: D_post folds0-3 only; fold4 remains unopened
stage1_measurement_contract.future_metrics: for each seed and each of joint64/main32, compute task-equal nMSE on all folds0-3 episodes for A, identity, B, and C; episode-block bootstrap is task-stratified with 10000 replicates and the fixed role-derived seed
stage1_measurement_contract.future_improvement: for each reference R in {identity,B,C} and coordinate set, define 1-nMSE(A)/nMSE(R) from task-equal aggregate nMSE; denominator<=1e-12 or nonfinite fails; compute each reference separately in every bootstrap replicate and require point>=0.05 plus one-sided0.05-quantile LCB>0 for all six comparisons
stage1_measurement_contract.residual_ratio: for each task compute sqrt(mean over all folds0-3 samples,tokens,features of (m_A-h)^2) divided by sqrt(mean h^2); require the equal mean over ten tasks <=0.10; zero denominator or nonfinite fails
stage1_measurement_contract.interface_parity: on the frozen ten-task D_adapter parity manifest, for every seed compare identity-adapter direct vs base, direct vs cached, and direct vs hot-switch normalized actions; maximum over all tasks,traces,windows,tokens,coordinates must be <1e-6
stage1_measurement_contract.fold4_prohibition: no Stage1 eligibility statistic may read a fold4 feature, target, policy output, or outcome

stage1_every_seed: under stage1_measurement_contract, A valid-target joint64 and main32 nMSE each beat identity, B, and C by at least 5 percent with one-sided episode-bootstrap LCB >0
the task-equal adapter residual RMS / h RMS ratio on D_post folds0-3 is <=0.10
the frozen ten-task identity/direct-cache/hot-switch interface parity maximum is <1e-6
C matching, dose, optimizer, and nonfinite gates pass
eligibility.stage1_failure: any of the twenty fixed seeds failing Stage1 eligibility forbids simulation Stage1; no seed drop, replacement, timing-based cohort reduction, or result-adaptive extra seed
stage2_every_seed: P fold4 point R2 >= 0.02 and episode-bootstrap LCB > 0

on locked fold4, the task-equal P/Q removed-energy ratio and every one of the 80 task-token RMS normalized-action-change ratios use the frozen q_fit definitions, have denominators >1e-12, and lie in [0.9,1.1]
both persisted nuisance-overlap values for B_pred and B_Q are <=0.001
the frozen ten-task parity_contract passes for every seed with maximum normalized-action error <1e-6
every task passes the exact fold4 distance and normalized policy-action gates in empirical_support
eligibility.stage2_failure: any of the twenty fixed seeds failing Stage2 eligibility globally forbids simulation Stage2 but does not invalidate a passed simulation Stage1
eligibility.fold4_bootstrap: same 10000-replicate task-stratified episode-block procedure; the allocation gate requires at least three fold4 episodes for every task
eligibility.fold4_open_semantics: one sealed logical fold4 evaluation specification; an allowed unchanged-hash infrastructure retry may physically reread fold4 only if the failed attempt revealed no metric or eligibility value; ledger every physical access; any reveal, code/config/hash change, or non-allowlisted retry makes Stage2 ineligible

checkpoint_screen.evaluation_contract_ref: closed_loop_evaluation simulator_reset_seed, settle_contract, policy horizon, chunk execution, action postprocess, success, terminal-record, and retry rules apply identically; only checkpoint, task, and initial-state manifests differ
checkpoint_screen.qualification: pooled all-ten-task success rate in [0.2,0.8] and at least four tasks independently have success rate in [0.2,0.8]
checkpoint_screen.selection: among qualified checkpoints maximize eligible-task count; tie minimize absolute pooled all-task success rate minus 0.5; tie lower step
checkpoint_screen.selector_output: selected checkpoint identity, all ten frozen task rates, treatment-blind primary eligible task IDs, selector-rule hash, and sealed-screen artifact hash
checkpoint_screen.detail_reveal: screen details may be revealed only after selected_checkpoint.json and primary_task_set.json are atomically written and hashed
checkpoint_screen.scientific_order: must complete before any selected-checkpoint cache, target/head fit, A/B/C training, P/Q fit, treatment rollout, or treatment outcome
checkpoint_screen.task_eligibility: on the selected checkpoint, task success rate in [0.2,0.8] on states0..4
checkpoint_screen.screen_scope: qualification is the sole checkpoint qualification source of truth; task_eligibility defines only the later frozen primary task set

closed_loop_evaluation.settle_contract: after env.reset and set_init_state, before the first policy observation, execute exactly ten native LIBERO actions [0,0,0,0,0,0,-1] as float32 lists; these actions do not count toward the 520 policy-action horizon; done, exception, nonfinite observation, or reset divergence during settling is a technical reset failure and never a success
closed_loop_evaluation.chunk_execution: open loop execute returned tokens in order, stopping immediately when done becomes true; unused tokens in that chunk are never executed; query again only after all8 tokens execute without done; horizon counts executed policy actions only

action_postprocess.dimensions0_to5: inverse minmax exactly x=(z+1)*(max-min)/2+min using action_normalization min/max, no clipping, float32
action_postprocess.dimension6: identity model output open_gripper; environment gripper command is float32 [1-2*(open_gripper>0.5)], so >0.5 maps to -1 and otherwise +1; no clipping
action_postprocess.environment_action: concatenate three world-vector deltas, three rotation deltas, and the binarized gripper into an exact length7 float32 list
action_postprocess.invalid: wrong shape or any nonfinite commanded/denormalized value terminates the logical record as a scientific policy failure and permanently fails that seed/stage gate; never substitute a dummy action
action_postprocess.logging: for every policy query and executed token persist hashes of commanded normalized chunk, denormalized six-axis values plus raw open_gripper, final environment action, and simulator-returned observation/reward/done/info; in simulation the submitted environment action is the executed action

closed_loop_evaluation.horizon: done false at horizon is a failure
closed_loop_evaluation.exception_or_missing: stage invalid; never convert to a failure success label and never impute
closed_loop_evaluation.rollout_pairing: for every train_seed x task x state cell, every compared condition uses simulator_reset_seed7, the same frozen environment/source hash, a fresh environment/reset, the same initial-state bytes, and a paired-manifest hash; condition order may be scheduled differently but no environment state is reused

stage1.primary_tasks: treatment-blind primary eligible set selected before any treatment

estimand_contract.paired_record: for each train seed, suite task, and initial state, subtract binary success indicators for the named conditions using the same seed-task-state cell
estimand_contract.seed_primary_value: equal mean of paired differences over the frozen primary tasks and states5..14
estimand_contract.cohort_pooled_primary_pp: 100 times the equal mean of paired differences over the cohort's 10 seeds, frozen primary tasks, and states5..14
estimand_contract.combined_primary_task_pp: for each frozen primary task and contrast, 100 times the equal mean over all 20 seeds and states5..14
estimand_contract.cohort_task_pp: for each cohort, frozen primary task, and contrast, 100 times the equal mean over that cohort's 10 seeds and states5..14
estimand_contract.gate_scope: apply the sign and per-cohort >=10pp gates separately in both cohorts and separately to A-B and A-C; apply the combined20 per-primary-task nonnegative gate separately to both contrasts; apply the cohort-task reversal floor separately by cohort, task, and contrast
estimand_contract.c_vs_b_scope: in each cohort, 100 times the equal primary-task/state/seed mean of C-B must be >=-5pp

stage1.per_cohort_sign_gate: at least 9 of 10 seed-level primary-task-average paired differences positive; ties nonpositive; exact one-sided p=11/1024
stage1.derived_combined_consistency: report the combined positive-seed count and exact sign probability descriptively; because both preregistered cohort gates already imply at least18/20, it is not a third gate or independent evidence
stage1.all_ten_task_coverage: mandatory secondary report; never hide an ineligible baseline task

stage2.primary_tasks: same frozen primary eligible set as Stage1

estimand_contract.paired_record: for each train seed, suite task, and initial state, subtract binary success indicators using the same seed-task-state cell
estimand_contract.seed_primary_value: equal mean of A_Q_removed-A_pred_removed over the frozen primary tasks and states5..14
estimand_contract.cohort_pooled_primary_pp: 100 times the equal mean over the cohort's 10 seeds, frozen primary tasks, and states5..14
estimand_contract.combined_primary_task_pp: for each frozen primary task, 100 times the equal mean over all 20 seeds and states5..14
estimand_contract.intact_comparisons: within each cohort use the same seeds/tasks/states and Stage1 records: require abs(100*mean(A_Q_removed-A))<=5pp; require denominator mean(A-B)>0 and mean(A-A_pred_removed)/mean(A-B)>=0.5; require 100*mean(A_pred_removed-B)>=-10pp
estimand_contract.gate_scope: the sign, >=10pp, intact-A, erasure, and B-floor gates must pass separately in both cohorts; the each-primary-task nonnegative gate applies to the combined20-seed estimand only

stage2.per_cohort_sign_gate: at least9 of10 seed-level primary values positive; ties are nonpositive; exact one-sided p=11/1024

stage2_online_inference.shared_input: at each policy query, preprocess one current observation and instruction once and run the frozen Qwen backbone once to obtain the same base h for A and B
stage2_online_inference.dual_adapter: apply the frozen A and B adapters to that same h, compute raw per-token m_A-m_B and its mean, then compute x,v_pred,v_q with locked linear artifacts; no prior-query representation cache may survive an observation change
stage2_online_inference.condition_path: A_pred_removed and A_Q_removed use the identical code path, dtype, backbone output, adapters, action head, chunk scheduler, and logging; the only branch selects the locked projector vector subtracted from every A token
stage2_online_inference.forbidden_online_inputs: DINO, progress, demonstrated action, future frame/target, teacher output, and rollout outcome
stage2_online_inference.telemetry: record per-query end-to-end latency, backbone/dual-adapter/projector/action-head component latency, peak memory, and timeout/staleness; synchronous simulation inference time does not consume one of the520 action steps
stage2_online_inference.real_transfer: C2-R requires a separately reviewed latency/control-frequency contract; C2-S feasibility never authorizes this dual-adapter path on hardware

cohorts.reveal: comparative training and rollout outcomes remain sealed until both fixed cohorts reach a hashed terminal manifest containing every seed as passed or failed; an incomplete cohort may be opened only to the integrity auditor after a terminal-invalid manifest, never for a claim

confidence_intervals.sampling: inside primary and replication cohorts separately, resample the10 train-seed IDs with replacement and retain each sampled seed's complete paired condition-by-task-by-state block; tasks and states are fixed benchmark estimands and are not resampled
confidence_intervals.combined: for a combined descriptive summary, independently resample each cohort as above and concatenate the two sampled 10-seed blocks
confidence_intervals.interval: two-sided [0.025,0.975] percentile using NumPy quantile method inverted_cdf
confidence_intervals.rng: PCG64 rooted at stage1 seed29001 or stage2 seed29002 with domain-separated contrast and cohort labels
confidence_intervals.reports: Stage1 reports A-B and A-C separately for each cohort and combined; Stage2 reports its primary, Q-vs-intact-A, erasure numerator/denominator/ratio, and pred-vs-B separately for each cohort and combined
confidence_intervals.erasure_ratio_bootstrap: never drop, replace, or clip a replicate with mean(A-B)<=0; always report numerator and denominator intervals and the fraction of nonpositive bootstrap denominators; if any replicate denominator is <=0, label the ratio interval undefined/unbounded rather than manufacturing a finite percentile interval; the point decision gate still requires each cohort's full-sample mean(A-B)>0
confidence_intervals.gate_role: mandatory descriptive reporting only; the preregistered sign and effect floors remain the decision gates

classes.screen: seal raw metrics, stdout, stderr, videos, and trajectories until selected_checkpoint.json and primary_task_set.json are hashed
classes.stage1: normal reveal requires all 6000 expected records and a passing batch-manifest hash; if a required record remains missing after its allowed technical retry, freeze a terminal-invalid manifest and permit audit-only reveal, with the Stage1 claim gate permanently failed
classes.stage2: normal reveal requires all 4000 expected records and a passing batch-manifest hash; if a required record remains missing after its allowed technical retry, freeze a terminal-invalid manifest and permit audit-only reveal, with the Stage2 claim gate permanently failed
classes.cohort_training: seal A/B/C comparative losses, nMSE, R2, P/Q score, and arm comparisons until all twenty fixed seeds and their terminal artifact manifest complete; before reveal expose only the exact stdout_whitelist_before_reveal fields

outcome_isolation.wandb: offline only and sealed with its phase
outcome_isolation.failed_attempts: preserve and charge; never delete or overwrite
outcome_isolation.cohort_rule: there is no timing-based seed count decision and no result-adaptive extra seed; primary and replication cohorts are both mandatory
outcome_isolation.pre_reveal_forbidden_fields: never disclose arm or condition identity, success, reward, task outcome, loss, nMSE, R2, C0/P/Q/eligibility/Stage gate, threshold comparison, per-arm nonfinite, or any boolean derived from a scientific metric; a real hard-safety event causes immediate stop and required operator disclosure but may never alter task/trial design

launch_guard.snapshot: one fresh nvidia-smi/NVML snapshot of physical indices 0-3, hardware UUIDs, compute PIDs, process owners when readable, memory used, and utilization

reservation.acquire: after the first passing snapshot and before process launch, acquire each selected hardware UUID in sorted UUID order with atomic os.open(path,O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_WRONLY,0o600); write canonical JSON containing host, boot_id, hardware_uuid, launch_uuid, uid, pid, pgid, proc_start_ticks, acquired UTC/monotonic, and lease_deadline; fsync file and parent; if any acquisition fails, archive only this launch's already-acquired reservations and launch nothing
reservation.after_acquire: take a second <=5-second snapshot while holding every reservation; the GPU must still satisfy idle_definition and UUID mapping or this launch fails closed before CUDA context
reservation.heartbeat: the owning wrapper refreshes lease_deadline atomically at least every30 seconds while any child or CUDA context exists
reservation.stale_lock: never clear merely from age; a separate guard may atomically rename a lock into a personal audit archive only after same uid/host/boot_id validation, lease expiry, owning PID absence or proc_start_ticks mismatch, no NVML compute PID for that UUID, and a second confirming snapshot; then restart acquisition from a new snapshot
reservation.release: after every owned child exits and post-exit NVML shows no launch PID on the UUID, atomically rename the owned reservation into the personal audit archive with release timestamps; never unlink, overwrite, or alter another launch's lock
reservation.concurrency: actual simultaneous jobs are at most min(4, count of physical UUIDs that are freshly idle and atomically reserved by this run)

launch_guard.idle_definition: no compute process, memory.used <= 500 MiB, and utilization.gpu <= 5 percent
launch_guard.normal_rule: choose currently idle physical 2 then 3 first; after those, physical 0 and 1 may be used individually when each candidate is idle in that launch's fresh snapshot
launch_guard.gpu_0_1_rule: all-four-idle is not required; physical 0 or 1 is allowed only if its own fresh snapshot satisfies the idle definition and it has no unrelated compute PID
launch_guard.post_bind: after CUDA context creation, take a second snapshot and verify assigned UUIDs and that every new PID belongs to this launch PID/PGID; an occupancy race stops only this launch
launch_guard.failure: fail closed, charge any elapsed GPU time, preserve artifacts, and never kill or attach to an external PID

failure_and_retry.scientific_gate_failure: stop or narrow that lane exactly as specified; never tune a threshold, drop or replace a seed, or add result-adaptive seeds
failure_and_retry.infrastructure_retry: only an allowlisted class may receive at most one unchanged-code, unchanged-config, unchanged-input, same-seed and same-condition retry per logical job; use a new launch UUID, preserve the old attempt, and keep all outcomes sealed

infrastructure_retry_classes.launcher_transport_before_exec_ack: SSH or wrapper transport fails before the remote child acknowledges exec and before any scientific input is read
infrastructure_retry_classes.cuda_context_before_scientific_read: structured CUDA context/driver initialization error occurs before model/data scientific evaluation; OOM, nonfinite, and user-code exceptions are excluded
infrastructure_retry_classes.personal_storage_transient_before_update: structured EIO or ETIMEDOUT on a checksum-verified personal input before any optimizer update, holdout score, or policy action; checksum mismatch and ENOSPC are excluded
infrastructure_retry_classes.simulation_reset_before_policy_action: structured simulator creation/reset/camera exception occurs before the first policy action and after no task outcome was emitted
infrastructure_retry_classes.real_transport_before_task_action: a frozen real-contract transport/heartbeat class occurs before the first task-relevant action and triggers verified safe hold

failure_and_retry.unlisted_or_changed: no retry; a code, config, threshold, task, seed, input, hardware-interface, or command change requires a new logical run, new hashes, and the applicable fresh review rather than a technical retry
failure_and_retry.simulation_rollout_policy: only simulation_reset_before_policy_action may retry a rollout; ordinary task failure, policy-caused simulator failure, or any exception after the first policy action is never retried; a second technical failure makes that required record terminal-missing and permanently fails the stage claim gate
failure_and_retry.real_robot_policy: a treatment-blind hardware fault before the first task-relevant action may receive the separately frozen technical retry; policy-caused safety abort is a failure and safety event and is never retried; ordinary task failure is never retried
failure_and_retry.logical_record_terminal: a required record is terminal only as valid success, valid ordinary/horizon/policy-safety failure, or terminal technical missing after its one allowed retry; complete never means all records succeeded
failure_and_retry.incomplete_sealed_batch: in simulation, any required record terminal-missing after the one allowed technical retry permanently fails that stage's claim gate; an integrity audit may explain the missingness and inspect an audit-only terminal reveal but may not waive, impute, or convert it into a claim

validation_lanes.order_policy: parallel or evidence-driven; there is no simulation-first requirement

includes: personal isolated source and environment locks

real_robot.status: awaiting endpoint, interface, embodiment, domain, task, data, safety, scientific-design, and exact-experiment-approval contract
required_before_live_action: one personal-root contract JSON path and SHA256 binding every item below; supplied prose alone grants no authority

robot, arm, gripper, camera, and a calibrated force/torque sensor or controller joint-torque/force-estimate source with identity, sample rate, thresholds, and logs; if neither force source exists, live motion is forbidden and missing telemetry cannot count as zero violations
controller SDK, endpoint host and port, transport, authentication boundary, API version, and exact command-namespace allowlist
action dimension, units, coordinate frame, control frequency and chunk semantics
workspace, joint, velocity, acceleration, force, torque and gripper limits
collision detection, heartbeat/network-loss safe stop and per-episode timeout
a compatible executable frozen VLA checkpoint and all licensed personal training/demonstration data required by PGR; neither may substitute for the other
evidence that the hidden/action interface is compatible with the common StarVLA PGR contract, otherwise a separately reviewed real-method contract
exact tasks, reset bins, sessions, trials per condition, block count, stopping rule, terminal missingness rule, statistical unit, estimands, gates, and confidence intervals
carryover and washout control plus reset-state verification
frozen task, reset-state and success-detection protocol

for every motion canary, exact command vector or trajectory, speed/acceleration/force/torque caps, duration and action count, object-absence/reset condition, operator position, abort predicates, expected observations, and a hashed per-level GO artifact
collision, hard-limit, and operator-E-stop acceptance count exactly zero plus exact noninferiority bounds for every other safety metric
human approval of the exact hashed experiment, not general robot availability
real_robot.note: This sequence is hardware safety, not a simulation-first scientific requirement; zero/hold is a live command and therefore occurs only after the complete contract and separate jury, while observe-only sends no command; baseline-canary tasks and trial counts freeze before the canary and its outcome cannot change the later task/trial design.

validation_lanes.reporting: S and R are analyzed separately. Two passed lanes provide independent convergent cross-domain evidence; replication wording additionally requires the frozen real contract to preserve the simulation estimand, task semantics, intervention, and comparator.

compute_telemetry.purpose: provenance, scheduling, throughput comparison, and hung-job detection only
compute_telemetry.actual_gpu_hours: for each physical GPU UUID, measure the union of this run's launch intervals; sum union lengths across UUIDs and divide by 3600
compute_telemetry.child_process_rule: children included in a charged launch envelope are attributed but not counted twice
compute_telemetry.timeout_rule: each logical job has a preregistered expected wall time and a hung timeout no shorter than twice the measured or conservative expected time; timeout stops only its own PGID and is not a scientific budget stop
compute_telemetry.fixed_compute_plan: twenty seeds and all-ten-task coverage are fixed before treatment outcomes; no timing-based 5/10 decision

real_robot_safety.blocker: the exact hashed endpoint, interface, embodiment, domain, task, data, safety, scientific-design, and human experiment-approval contract is absent and has not passed a separate jury
real_robot_safety.unlock: never automatic on receipt; requires contract validation, compatible reviewed RobotAdapter implementation, observe-only evidence, and separate safety/scientific GO bound to hashes
real_robot_safety.action_source_rule: if a safety filter modifies an action, predictive targets use the actually executed action; log both pre-filter and post-filter actions
real_robot_safety.primary_task_metric: success rate; safety metrics remain separate and cannot be hidden in a composite score
real_robot_safety.required_randomization: use randomized complete blocks only: each frozen task x reset-bin x session block contains every compared condition exactly once; generate opaque condition order with PCG64 seed47001 after exact labels/counts freeze, persist the full sequence hash before canaries, and never reorder from outcomes
real_robot_safety.safety_acceptance: collision count=0, hard joint/workspace/velocity/acceleration/force/torque limit violations=0, and operator E-stop count=0; exact latency, stale-command, safety-filter, clipping, heartbeat, and soft-limit noninferiority bounds must be numeric in the future contract before any motion
real_robot_safety.technical_retry: only a preregistered allowlisted treatment-blind technical class before the first task-relevant action may receive one unchanged-condition retry; every attempt is preserved
real_robot_safety.success_and_safety: success is primary task efficacy; every safety metric is a separate co-reported endpoint and no composite may hide a violation
